claims.statement: Dropbox issues an app secret (client_secret) together with an app key (client_id) when an app is registered in the App Console; it authenticates the app at /oauth2/token and is the signing key for webhook notification signatures.

sources.supports: obtaining an app key and secret (a.k.a. client_id and client_secret)
Calls to /oauth2/token need to be authenticated using the apps's key and secret.
HMAC-SHA256 signature of the request body, using your app secret as the signing key

notes: Project-authored by the Redact Secret project, which maintains this repository; not independent evidence. Draft; not yet reviewed.

openQuestions.question: Candidate documented at existence level only. The pages read state no prefix, alphabet or length for the app secret; the app key (client_id) sits beside it and is a public-identifier question for research-family, not a credential family.
